  "implementation": "def solve(case):
    matrix = case['matrix']
    idf = case['idf']
    vector = case['vector']
    n_docs = len(matrix)
    n_terms = len(idf)
    degree = [0.0] * n_terms
    result = [0.0] * n_docs
    for i in range(n_docs):
        row = matrix[i]
        vec_i = vector[i]
        row_sum = 0.0
        for j in range(n_terms):
            term_weight = row[j] * idf[j]
            degree[j] += term_weight * vec_i
            row_sum += term_weight
        result[i] = row_sum * vec_i
    return {'degree': degree, 'result': result}"
}
